gps_source: IGS rapid SP3 (IGS0OPSRAP, BKG), consecutive daily files

pattern.source: Main lobe: 23.5 deg L1 reference half-beamwidth of the GPS III Space Service Volume specification, which 'corresponds approximately with the null between the main lobe and the first side lobe of most GPS satellites' (J. E. Donaldson, J. J. K. Parker, M. C. Moreau, D. E. Highsmith, P. Martzen, 'Characterization of On-Orbit GPS Transmit Antenna Patterns for Space Users', NAVIGATION 67(2), 2020, doi:10.1002/navi.361). Side lobes: GPS ACE reconstructed L1 transmit patterns from GEO flight data agree with ground measurements 'from main lobe out to the second and third sidelobes (70 degrees off boresight)' (Donaldson et al., ION GNSS+ 2018 presentation, NASA NTRS 20180007029).

receiver_note: MMS receive antenna coverage is treated as omnidirectional: each spin-stabilized MMS spacecraft carries several GPS antennas around its body, so no receive-side masking is applied. Receiver sensitivity is not modeled.
